title: Come Up
alt: Four panels in the office at night. Panel 1: The brass pneumatic tube on the left wall goes FWUMP. Pip, a lavender candle-wisp, holds a small folded note and reads it, looking wary; Margo, a tall grey-haired caseworker in round glasses and a mustard cardigan, is behind her desk, startled by the tube but not looking up. Pip: "'Please come up. -H.' Up where?" Margo: "He doesn't say." Panel 2: Margo is standing upright on top of her desk, note in hand, deadpan, next to her mug. Pip stares up at her with arms raised and a sweat drop. Margo: "Up." Panel 3: Back behind her desk, Margo brings her rubber stamp down beside the note, now marked HANDLED in red: KA-CHUNK. Pip, worried: "I think he meant the fifth floor." Margo: "Then he'd have said 'floor.'" Panel 4: The tube goes FWUMP again. Pip, smiling, holds up a second note that reads "Please come up further. -H." Margo, behind her desk, half-lidded. Pip: "He says 'further.'"
hover: Hollis has never needed more than one word. He has never needed fewer, either.
transcript: Panel 1 – PIP: "Please come up. -H." Up where?
Panel 2 – MARGO (standing on her desk): Up.
Panel 3 – SFX: KA-CHUNK (the note is stamped HANDLED)
Panel 3 – PIP: I think he meant the fifth floor.
Panel 3 – MARGO: Then he'd have said "floor."
Panel 4 – NOTE: Please come up further. -H.
note: Margo has been asked to go upstairs for forty years. She has found a great many ways to comply without going.
